issue.title: sase commit's quarantined-publication warning recommends a retry that can never clear v2 import identity collisions
issue.description:
Discovered by sase-ho.land while landing epic sase-ho (artifact reference xprompts); not caused by that epic.

REPRODUCTION (sase master 0a45feebc, workspace sase_11, 2026-08-08):
Every 'sase commit' in this project now ends with:

  Primary commit succeeded, but this project already has 3 quarantined agent-hood
  publication requests. The link written to this commit may remain unavailable until
  the outbox is cleared. Run 'sase agent sync --retry-quarantined' to retry.

Running exactly that command does not clear them. Two 'sase agent sync --retry-quarantined' runs back to back both print the identical residue:

  sase: bbugyi200.athena.03o: quarantined v2 import: imported agent name '03o' collides:
  owner, global identity, container kind, or artifact owner differs from the existing claim
  sase: bbugyi200.athena.077: quarantined v2 import: imported agent name '077' collides:
  owner, global identity, container kind, or artifact owner differs from the existing claim

and the count stays at 3, so the warning fires again on the very next commit. The same runs also report unrelated family-lane residue ('primary commit history for family lane bbugyi200.athena.88/.8g/.9n/.9r/.research.5.final.f1: retained N commit(s), but no family member run remains and v2 family containers require at least one member').

IMPACT: agent-hood pages for these identities stay unpublished, so the agent link written into every commit stays dead, and each commit tells the agent to run a remediation that is a guaranteed no-op. An agent that follows the instruction learns nothing and cannot tell a transient quarantine from a terminal one.

SCOPE: decide whether an identity collision of this shape is terminal and route it through the existing retire path from sase-ah.2 ('Retire publication requests that can never be published') instead of leaving it in quarantine forever, and stop the commit-time warning from recommending '--retry-quarantined' for requests that a retry provably cannot advance -- print the terminal reason and the actual remediation instead. Diagnosing why '03o' and '077' collide (owner / global identity / container kind / artifact owner) is part of the work. Related closed history: sase-ah, sase-ah.2, sase-ej, sase-fa, sase-f6, sase-fk.

NOT A DUPLICATE OF: sase-fk (bob-cli-specific digest drift, closed), sase-f6 (retired identities resurrected from commit footers, closed), sase-ah.2 (built the retire path but these requests are not taking it). No in-progress epic (sase-h7, sase-h8, sase-h8.10, sase-hb, sase-hf, sase-hn) has a causal link to agent-sync publication.
